name: Frappe Bench
postCreateCommand:
if [ "$FRAPPE_DEV_AGENTS" = 1 ]; then
  sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /home/frappe/.config
  sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$CODEX_HOME" "$T3CODE_HOME" "$GH_CONFIG_DIR" "$GLAB_CONFIG_DIR" /home/frappe/.agents
  cd /workspace/development
  python installer.py --apps-json "$FRAPPE_APPS_JSON" --bench-name "$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME" --site-name "$FRAPPE_SITE_NAME"
  cd "$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME"
  bench set-config -gp webserver_port 8000
  bench set-config -gp socketio_port 9000
  sed -i -E '/^web:[[:space:]]+bench serve([[:space:]]|$)/s/(^|[[:space:]])--port([[:space:]]+|=)[0-9]+/\1--port 8000/' Procfile
  bench --site "$FRAPPE_SITE_NAME" set-config -p socketio_port "$FRAPPE_REALTIME_PORT"
  uv pip freeze --python env/bin/python --exclude-editable > env/pre-commit-constraints.txt
  uv pip install --python env/bin/python --constraint env/pre-commit-constraints.txt pre-commit
  uv pip check --python env/bin/python
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends gh glab
  npm install --global @openai/codex "t3@${FRAPPE_T3_CHANNEL:-latest}"
  t3 --version
  npx --yes skills add frappe/skills --global --agent codex --skill '*' --yes --copy
  npx --yes skills add https://github.com/frappe/frappe-ui/tree/main/skills/frappe-ui --global --agent codex --yes --copy
  if [ -f /run/frappe-codex-auth.json ] && [ ! -e "$CODEX_HOME/auth.json" ]; then
    (umask 077; cp -n /run/frappe-codex-auth.json "$CODEX_HOME/auth.json")
  fi
else
  uv tool install pre-commit
fi
postStartCommand:
if [ "$FRAPPE_DEV_AGENTS" = 1 ]; then
  umask 077
  cd "/workspace/development/$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME" || exit 1
  export VIRTUAL_ENV="$PWD/env"
  export PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"
  unset PYTHONHOME
  test -x "$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python"
  t3_runtime="$(python - <<'T3_PREPARE'
import fcntl
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

LAUNCHER_PROTOCOL = 3
NUMBER = r"(?:0|[1-9]\d*)"
PRERELEASE = rf"(?:{NUMBER}|[0-9]*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)"
BUILD = r"[0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*"
VERSION = re.compile(
    rf"{NUMBER}\.{NUMBER}\.{NUMBER}(?:-{PRERELEASE}(?:\.{PRERELEASE})*)?(?:\+{BUILD})?"
)


class LifecycleError(Exception):
    pass


class T3Provisioning:
    def __init__(self):
        self.home = Path(os.environ["T3CODE_HOME"])
        self.state_file = self.home / "runtime/service-state.json"
        self.log = self.home / "devcontainer/server.log"
        self.server_lock = self.log.parent / "server.lock"

    def log_output(self, output):
        self.log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        descriptor = os.open(self.log, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND | os.O_CREAT, 0o600)
        os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w") as handle:
            handle.write(output)

    def command(self, arguments):
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                arguments, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, timeout=600
            )
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            raise LifecycleError(
                "T3 lifecycle command timed out; retry provisioning when downloads are available."
            ) from error
        if result.returncode:
            self.log_output(result.stdout + result.stderr)
            raise LifecycleError(
                f"T3 lifecycle command failed; inspect the private log at {self.log}."
            )
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def valid_version(version):
        if not isinstance(version, str) or not VERSION.fullmatch(version):
            raise LifecycleError("Invalid T3 runtime version in launcher state.")
        return version

    def read_state(self):
        state = json.loads(self.state_file.read_text())
        if not isinstance(state, dict) or state.get("protocol") != LAUNCHER_PROTOCOL:
            raise LifecycleError(
                "Unsupported T3 launcher state protocol; update the devcontainer integration."
            )
        self.valid_version(state.get("activeVersion"))
        if "update" in state and (
            not isinstance(state["update"], dict)
            or state["update"].get("status")
            not in ("pending", "committed", "rolled-back", "failed")
        ):
            raise LifecycleError(
                "Invalid T3 update record; preserve the state file for recovery."
            )
        return state

    def bootstrap_version(self):
        prefix = self.command(["npm", "root", "--global"]).stdout.strip()
        package = json.loads((Path(prefix) / "t3/package.json").read_text())
        return self.valid_version(package.get("version"))

    def runtime(self, version, preflight=True):
        version = self.valid_version(version)
        directory = self.home / "runtime/versions" / version
        sentinel = directory / ".install-complete"

        def complete():
            return (
                sentinel.is_file()
                and sentinel.read_text().strip() == version
                and (directory / "t3").is_file()
                and os.access(directory / "t3", os.X_OK)
                and (directory / "client/index.html").is_file()
                and (directory / "resource-monitor").is_dir()
                and (directory / "node_modules").is_dir()
            )

        if not complete():
            if directory.is_symlink():
                raise LifecycleError(
                    "Refusing to repair a symlinked T3 runtime directory."
                )
            # The npm launcher repairs an incomplete cache when its sentinel is absent.
            sentinel.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            print(
                f"Restoring the selected T3 runtime {version} through npm.",
                file=sys.stderr,
                flush=True,
            )
            self.command(["npx", "--yes", f"t3@{version}", "--version"])
            if not complete():
                raise LifecycleError(
                    "The selected T3 runtime remains incomplete after npm recovery."
                )

        executable = directory / "t3"
        if preflight:
            result = self.command(
                [
                    str(executable),
                    "__service-preflight",
                    "--database-path",
                    str(self.home / "userdata/statev2.sqlite"),
                    "--launcher-protocol",
                    str(LAUNCHER_PROTOCOL),
                ]
            )
            check = json.loads(result.stdout)
            if (
                check.get("status") != "ready"
                or check.get("version") != version
                or check.get("launcherProtocol") != LAUNCHER_PROTOCOL
            ):
                raise LifecycleError(
                    "This T3 runtime is incompatible with the devcontainer launcher integration."
                )
            help_text = self.command(
                [str(executable), "__service-launcher", "--help"]
            ).stdout
            if "__service-launcher" not in help_text:
                raise LifecycleError(
                    "The selected T3 runtime does not provide the expected launcher entrypoint."
                )
        return executable

    @staticmethod
    def write_once(path, value):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".t3-init-", dir=path.parent)
        try:
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w") as handle:
                json.dump(value, handle, indent=2)
                handle.write("\n")
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
            try:
                os.link(temporary, path)
            except FileExistsError:
                pass
            else:
                directory = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
                try:
                    os.fsync(directory)
                finally:
                    os.close(directory)
        finally:
            os.unlink(temporary)

    def seed_settings(self):
        source = Path("/run/frappe-t3-settings.json")
        destination = self.home / "userdata/settings.json"
        if destination.exists() or not source.is_file():
            return
        settings = json.loads(source.read_text())
        if not isinstance(settings, dict):
            raise LifecycleError("T3 settings must be a JSON object.")
        for key in list(settings):
            if (key.startswith("project") and key.endswith("Overrides")) or key in (
                "projectSettingsFolded",
                "worktreesDirectory",
                "previousWorktreesDirectories",
                "addProjectBaseDirectory",
                "environmentIcon",
                "deviceHosts",
                "easDeviceHosts",
                "sourceControlHosts",
                "usageLimitSources",
                "observability",
            ):
                del settings[key]
        for instance in settings.get("providerInstances", {}).values():
            config = instance.get("config")
            if isinstance(config, dict):
                for key in ("binaryPath", "homePath", "shadowHomePath"):
                    config.pop(key, None)
            if "environment" in instance:
                instance["environment"] = [
                    variable
                    for variable in instance["environment"]
                    if not variable.get("sensitive")
                    and not variable.get("valueRedacted")
                ]
        self.write_once(destination, settings)

    def server_running(self):
        with self.server_lock.open("a") as lock:
            try:
                fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            except BlockingIOError:
                return True
        return False

    def prepare(self):
        self.log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with (self.log.parent / "bootstrap.lock").open("a") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            running = self.server_running()
            if self.state_file.exists():
                state = self.read_state()
                pending = state.get("update", {}).get("status") == "pending"
                executable = self.runtime(
                    state["activeVersion"], preflight=not (pending or running)
                )
            elif running:
                raise LifecycleError(
                    "T3 is running without launcher state; preserve its home for repair."
                )
            else:
                version = self.bootstrap_version()
                executable = self.runtime(version)
                self.write_once(
                    self.state_file,
                    {"protocol": LAUNCHER_PROTOCOL, "activeVersion": version},
                )
                pending = False
            if not (pending or running):
                self.seed_settings()
            return executable


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.umask(0o077)
    print(T3Provisioning().prepare())
T3_PREPARE
)"
  server_log="$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer/server.log"
  touch "$server_log"
  chmod 600 "$server_log"
  # Detach the native launcher from the lifecycle hook's terminal.
  # flock keeps repeated hooks from starting another launcher for the same home.
  nohup setsid --fork flock --nonblock "$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer/server.lock" \
    "$t3_runtime" __service-launcher >> "$server_log" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  # Recovery must finish before the project command opens T3's database.
  t3_runtime="$(python - <<'T3_READY'
import http.client
import json
import os
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path


def wait_ready(home, port, timeout=240):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        state = json.loads((home / "runtime/service-state.json").read_text())
        version = state.get("activeVersion") if isinstance(state, dict) else None
        if (
            not isinstance(state, dict)
            or state.get("protocol") != 3
            or not isinstance(version, str)
            or not re.fullmatch(
                r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.+-]+)?", version
            )
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Unsupported T3 launcher state; preserve it for repair.")
        connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", port, timeout=2)
        try:
            connection.request("GET", "/.well-known/t3/environment")
            response = connection.getresponse()
            if response.status == 200:
                descriptor = json.loads(response.read())
                if (
                    state.get("update", {}).get("status") != "pending"
                    and descriptor.get("serverVersion") == version
                    and descriptor.get("capabilities", {}).get("serverSelfUpdate")
                    == "boot-service"
                ):
                    return home / "runtime/versions" / version / "t3"
        except (OSError, ValueError, http.client.HTTPException):
            pass
        finally:
            connection.close()
        time.sleep(0.5)
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Managed T3 startup did not complete; inspect {home}/devcontainer/server.log."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(wait_ready(Path(os.environ["T3CODE_HOME"]), int(os.environ["T3CODE_PORT"])))
T3_READY
)"
  if ! project_output="$("$t3_runtime" project add --base-dir "$T3CODE_HOME" --title "${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME}" "$PWD" 2>&1)"; then
    if [[ "$project_output" != *"ProjectAlreadyExistsError:"* ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$project_output" >> "$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer/server.log"
      printf 'T3 project registration failed; inspect %s/devcontainer/server.log.\n' "$T3CODE_HOME" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
fi
